name: vm-name
description: Name of the vm to delete. Optional if label-selector is set

name: label-selector
description: Label selector to target VMs (e.g. app=myvm). Optional if vm-name is set

name: timeout
description: Time that scneario will wait for VM to come back

name: kill-count
description: Number of VMIs to kill (performed serially)

name: wait-for-guest-ping
description: After VMI is Running, wait until guest answers ICMP ping (default) or TCP and record guest_reachable_time MTTR

name: guest-ping-timeout
description: Seconds to wait for first guest ping/TCP success after VMI Running

name: guest-ping-method
description: Reachability probe: icmp (default system ping; needs NET_RAW) or tcp

name: guest-ping-port
description: TCP port used when guest-ping-method=tcp (ignored for icmp)

name: guest-ping-namespace
description: Namespace for the probe pod; empty defaults to the VMI namespace

name: guest-ping-pod
description: Leave empty for icmp (ephemeral helper with NET_RAW). For tcp, optionally reuse CI/templates/guest-ping-diagnosis-pod.yaml

name: guest-ping-image
description: Container image for the ephemeral guest probe helper (must include ping/nc). Override for disconnected or mirrored registries

name: guest-ping-settle-seconds
description: Seconds to sleep after the helper probe pod is Ready, before deleting the VMI
